title: Proofnote Document Format 1.0
description: The extensible, portable block-document format used by Proofnote. Typography is selected through constrained presets rather than arbitrary style values.

language.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag for exported document language metadata, for example zh-CN or en.

runningHeader.description: Optional editable left and right running-header labels for documents that use a repeated page header.

headerSubtitle.description: Optional display setting for the editable subtitle immediately beneath a document title. The subtitle block remains in the document when hidden.

proofMetadata.description: Optional Proof Note display settings. Omit to show Author, Date, and Status.

compatibility.description: Optional migration metadata; not required by new documents.

id.description: Stable editor identifier. Proofnote generates one when importing AI-authored JSON; duplicate IDs are regenerated.

preset.description: A Proofnote-controlled typography or component preset. Proofnote derives it when omitted.

kind.description: Semantic blocks accept section, introduction, problem, theorem, proof, result, or verification; callouts accept note, tip, warning, or info.

appearance.description: An optional template-controlled semantic presentation. Omit to inherit the template default.

header.description: Optional table display setting. Omit or true renders columns as a header row; false renders all rows as body cells.

src.description: Local data images or HTTPS URLs. Remote images require explicit user approval before loading.

remoteApproved.description: Local editor state only. Proofnote ignores this field when importing a document.
